name: seo-page-audit
summary: Run a bounded single-page SEO evidence audit and return quality-gated findings.
inputs: target URL or local HTML path
external_reads: target URL when the target is live
linked page assets requested by the selected tool
approval_gates: external_read: obtain approval before crawling a live URL or its linked assets
vault_write: obtain approval before saving evidence unless vault_write is already authorized
production and external mutation: out of scope; this workflow never publishes or changes a site
done_when: target, scope, environment, and approval boundary are explicit
the smallest suitable tool set ran or a blocked/setup-required state is recorded
raw stdout, stderr, metadata, and normalized packets are saved under the evidence root
findings distinguish observed page evidence from heuristics and hypotheses
seo-quality-gate passed or was explicitly deferred with a reason
verification: verify selected tools are registered and installed or record the missing command
verify every executed command is bounded and has a captured exit status
verify raw and normalized artifacts exist and preserve partial or blocked state
verify no ranking, indexing, traffic, conversion, or AI-citation guarantee is claimed
verify seo-quality-gate evaluates the interpreted findings
